caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned openly on a plain, off-white background. The chair features an arched back with multiple slender vertical spindles, an oval, slightly indented seat, and two wooden armrests supported by short, turned arms. The legs are splayed outward and connected by stretchers, with turned detailing on each of the four legs and supporting structures. The entire chair is rendered in shades of brown and gray pencil, with shading suggesting three-dimensional form and a light source from the left. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition, and the chair is the only subject in the frame.
title: Windsor Chair
